scoring_note.description: The documented staleness formula assigns staleness_score=0-5 to countries assessed within roughly the last month, and importance_score is capped at 12 for the countries index regardless of severity. As a result, active mass-casualty conflicts and famine-risk states (Sudan, Iran, Israel/Palestine, Russia/Ukraine, DRC, Haiti, South Sudan, Somalia, Nigeria, Mali, Afghanistan, Pakistan) frequently score priority_score in the 32-62 range -- at or below routine Fortune-500/AI-lab items that score a flat 50 purely for being "never assessed" and near a composite band boundary (e.g., dozens of never-assessed Fortune 500 entities with no material news this cycle). This is the same inversion documented on 2026-07-22 and prior cycles. The formula is applied exactly as documented; this note records the inversion rather than silently overriding scores. Sudan in particular carries a severity-critical ongoing siege (El Obeid) but scored priority_score=17 with no evidence_found this cycle because the only confirmed reporting fell just outside the 14-day window (Jul 2-6) -- see sector_alerts sa-2026-07-23-01.
